currency.basis: Historical closed bank (license revoked 2018-10-25). The candidate represents the final pre-2018 brand, the relevant period for this catalog entry.

identity.basis: Catalog record 4502 Уралтрансбанк, RU, utb.ru matches АБ «Уралтрансбанк» (Yekaterinburg, OGRN 1026600001779). CDNLogo's Uraltransbank entry depicts the bank's locomotive emblem; the similarly named «УралТранс» publishing-house entries on worldvectorlogo/seeklogo were inspected and rejected as a different entity.

assessment.independenceRationale: Third-party vector cross-checked against an independent raster aid (bootflare PNG, separate source) and against CBR closure facts; identity confirmed by emblem content, not by counting mirrors.
uncertainties: Third-party (CDNLogo) provenance rather than official bank source; the official domain never served SVG per CDX.
No emblem-only or colored official vector variant exists in any reachable source; the lockup will be reduced to its emblem region during preparation.
Post-2014 discovery of the actual origin file (print EPS) is not traceable further within budget.

variant.basis: Monochrome black lockup with white canvas; emblem-only isolation planned. Colored historical vector variants were not found anywhere; the monochrome form matches the brand's print-era representation.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Boiler bands, wheels, coupling rods, cowcatcher, bell and smokestack of the source locomotive are all present in the final render; internal cutouts remain transparent; no clipping or artifacts at 240/48/32/24 px diagnostics.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Locomotive aspect (~1.8:1) preserved without stretching; fits the square cell with margins and reads clearly at 32-48 px on light background. Known limitation: the authentic monochrome black mark has low contrast on the dark theme (#121212); recoloring is not permitted, and no white/light official vector variant was found in any reachable source, so the source-backed monochrome form is kept and this is disclosed for reviewer judgment.
candidate.rationale: First addition for a closed bank (license revoked 2018-10-25) with no icon. The CDNLogo original vector of the final-period logo is a full lockup; the standalone steam-locomotive emblem is selected unchanged. Emblem geometry is preserved byte-for-byte; only the white canvas rect (background) is removed and the viewport is restricted to the emblem region. No colored or emblem-only official vector exists anywhere reachable.
candidate.role: Standalone locomotive emblem portion of the final-period logo lockup; «УралТрансБанк» wordmark, the «1947» date and the full-width rule are separate lockup elements, not part of the mark.
transforms: Source selection: white background rect (M0 0h192.756v192.756H0V0z) removed — background-only change, no emblem pixel touched; viewport restricted to viewBox 7.6 38.8 104.9 57.7 covering the complete locomotive including cowcatcher, bell and stack. No emblem geometry, scale or translation change; wordmark/1947/rule paths remain in the file but render outside the viewport.

SVGO 4.1.0, repository svgo.config.mjs (config sha256 bound to baseCommit): 22118 -> 20702 bytes; optimized trial compared visually against the working version with rsvg-convert on both theme canvases, faithful, selected as final bytes.
candidate.variant: Monochrome black print-era variant on a transparent field after background removal; no circular official avatar observed and no colored vector variant exists, so transparency is kept without an added backing.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this bank, so the visible difference is absence to a rendered standalone emblem; no baseline comparison exists or is invented.

proposals.reason: Original vector of Уралтрансбанк's final-period logo (black steam-locomotive emblem above «УралТрансБанк» wordmark with «1947») obtained from CDNLogo (viewBox 0 0 192.756 192.756, 22166 bytes). Bank closed: license revoked 2018-10-25 (OGRN 1026600001779), so the relevant brand period is the pre-2018 operating era. The asset is a full lockup with a white canvas rect; a standalone emblem-only working variant will be prepared at candidate review by selecting the emblem region and dropping the background rect (no tracing). Third-party provenance: no official vector exists in the archived utb.ru domain.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector of the closed bank's final-period logo from the largest reachable vector source; visually confirmed against an independent raster cross-check. Lockup with white canvas rect; the standalone emblem region will be selected at candidate review without altering emblem geometry.

sources.observation: Retrieval row: after repeated direct 30s timeouts on static.cdnlogo.com, the identical asset was retrieved through the translate.goog fetch of the same URL (sha256 0f6b4836aff35f45b5a283603ef7cda679fa4719cd80f9db202b043d03c74c27, 22166 bytes); bytes validated as well-formed SVG.

sources.independenceGroup: CDNLogo vector (primary asset) with independent bootflare raster cross-check
sources.observation: CDNLogo listing page for Uraltransbank; its asset uraltransbank.svg is a clean vector (glyph-level letter outlines and smooth locomotive paths, not an autotrace of the raster aid). Direct static.cdnlogo.com transfer repeatedly timed out at 30s; full bytes (sha256 0f6b4836aff35f45b5a283603ef7cda679fa4719cd80f9db202b043d03c74c27) retrieved via the translate.goog proxy of the same asset and validated as well-formed SVG. Rendered and visually matched against the independent bootflare PNG raster aid.
Wayback CDX scan of utb.ru for image/svg+xml: zero results; no official vector was ever archived on the bank's domain.

Bank of Russia press release: Уралтрансбанк license revoked 2018-10-25 (OGRN 1026600001779); final brand period is pre-2018-10. Candidate matches independently confirmed brand imagery of that period (locomotive emblem + wordmark, monochrome black).
